http/proxy_tunnel#

A CONNECT tunnel on a proxy connection: the request, and the proxy's answer read byte by byte so that TLS can follow on the same stream.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

A CONNECT tunnel on a proxy connection: the request, and the proxy's answer read byte by byte so that TLS can follow on the same stream.

Public API#

object HttpProxyTunnel#

object HttpProxyTunnel

Borrowed raw halves. Reading one byte at a time avoids consuming a tunnel prefix that the native TLS handshake must receive from the same TCP stream.

HttpProxyTunnel.HttpProxyTunnel#

HttpProxyTunnel(input is AsyncReading, output is AsyncWriting, target is UrlParts, fields is @Header)

A tunnel to target over input and output, with the default limits.

HttpProxyTunnel.HttpProxyTunnel#

HttpProxyTunnel(input is AsyncReading, output is AsyncWriting, target is UrlParts, fields is @Header, limits is Http1Limits)

The same within limits.

HttpProxyTunnel.ready#

async ready() is bool

Sends CONNECT and waits for a 2xx; ProxyConnectRejected for another status.
